text: The account holder is Hina Rehman with account number PK**MEZN****8626, opened on 13 June 2025. The subject is a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month. Between 5 March 2026 and 11 March 2026, the account received 12 credits totalling PKR 660,000 and made 3 debits totalling PKR 606,000. All 12 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 12 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 11 March 2026, scoring a MULE-01 typology of 360 against a threshold of 300. The presence of 12 distinct senders in a short period is indicative of a potential money mule scenario. Debits equal to 92% of credits with a median of 3.7 hours between the latest credit and each debit suggest rapid value movement. The credits amounting to 33.0 times the declared monthly income are inconsistent with the subject’s Student profile and declared income. Two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints. Taken together, these indicators are consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 381,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. PKR 225,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 1 transaction. No match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening was found on 30 March 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
